common.tagline: Your karaoke, in a fair queue

landing.title: Sing in turn, no fighting over the mic
landing.subtitle: Scan the QR code on your table, pick a song, and see exactly when you're up.

scan.title: Scan
scan.body: The QR code on your table, or type the code next to it.

pick.title: Pick a song
pick.body: From the venue's catalog, solo or with friends.

sing.title: Sing
sing.body: Watch your place in line and know when it's your turn.

landing.choose: How would you like to continue?

newUser.title: I'm new here
newUser.body: Create an account to keep your songs between nights.

existingUser.title: I have an account
existingUser.body: Sign in with email, phone, Google or Microsoft.

signin.title: Welcome back
signin.subtitle: Sign in the way you signed up.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Pick one way to sign up.

auth.resetSent: If {email} has an account, we sent it a link to reset the password.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it on this phone to finish signing up.

auth.guestHint: Just here to sing? Guests don't need an account.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You'll use it the next time you sign in with your email.

auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not set up in this environment yet.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Israeli number, e.g. 050-123-4567
errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent you.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a password with at least 8 characters
errors.alreadyRegistered: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.
errors.noAccount: No account uses this number yet. Create one first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.auth: We couldn't finish signing you in. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

join.title: Join your table
join.subtitle: Scan the QR code on your table, or type the code printed next to it.
join.scanHint: See a QR code on your table? Scan it with your camera and the code fills itself in.
join.codeHint: 4–8 letters and digits, printed next to the QR code
join.namePlaceholder: The name the DJ will call out
join.nameHint: Just tell us what to call you.

errors.invalidCode: A table code is 4–8 letters and digits.
errors.nameRequired: Tell us your name (up to 40 characters).
errors.notFound: We couldn't find a table with that code. Check it again or ask the staff.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.identity: We couldn't sign you in right now. Wait a moment and tap Join again.

tokenNotFound.title: This QR code is no longer active
tokenNotFound.body: Type the table code instead, or ask the staff for a fresh one.

status.open: Pick a song from the catalog to get in line.
status.closed: The DJ hasn't opened the queue yet. Browse the catalog and pick your song in the meantime.
status.gone: This table is no longer active. Scan a new QR code or ask the staff for a code.
status.unknown: We couldn't check on the night. We'll try again in a moment.

search.title: Find a song
search.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# song} other {# songs}}
search.noResults: No songs match “{query}”. Try the artist or another word.
search.browseOnly: Browse ahead. Requesting opens when the night starts.

errors.noSession: Join a table to search the catalog.
errors.unavailable: Search is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

request.title: Request a song
request.notePlaceholder: Birthday, key change, no guide vocals…

errors.noSession: Join a table to request a song.
errors.noIdentity: We couldn't sign you in as a guest yet. Tap Try again at the top of the page.
errors.notParticipant: You're not at a table in tonight's queue. Rejoin your table and try again.
errors.invalidInput: Check the song and the singers' names.
errors.unavailable: The request didn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.

queue.title: Your songs
queue.length: {count, plural, =0 {queue is empty} one {# song in the queue} other {# songs in the queue}}
queue.empty: You haven't requested anything yet. Pick a song from the catalog below.
queue.closed: The queue opens when the DJ starts the night.
queue.youreNext: You're up next! {title} follows this song. Make your way to the stage.
queue.awaitingApproval: Waiting for the DJ to approve
queue.ahead: {ahead, plural, =0 {you're next} one {# song before you} other {# songs before you}}

errors.noSession: Join a table to see the queue.
errors.noIdentity: We couldn't sign you in as a guest yet, so the queue and requests are off for now.
errors.notParticipant: You're not at a table in tonight's queue. Rejoin your table.
errors.invalidInput: Something was off with that request.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't reach the queue. We'll retry shortly.

reject.maxPendingUser: You already have a song waiting. You can request another once it's sung.
reject.maxPendingTable: Your table already has the maximum number of songs waiting.
reject.cooldown: You just sang! Take a short break before your next song.
reject.duplicateSong: That song was requested or sung recently. Pick another one.
reject.nightClosed: The night isn't open right now.
reject.cutoff: Requests are closed for tonight. The night is about to end.
reject.tooManySingers: Too many singers for one song. Remove a name and try again.
reject.duetsDisabled: Duets aren't allowed tonight. One singer per song.
reject.songInactive: This song isn't available at the moment.

app.noNight: You haven't joined a night yet. Scan the QR code on your table.

dj.title: DJ console
dj.demoHint: Supabase isn't configured, so changes stay in this browser.

night.confirmClose: Close the night? {count} waiting requests will be skipped.
night.closedBody: Open a night so guests can request songs. The queue, player and mixer wake up with it.

notStaff.title: You're not on any venue's staff
notStaff.body: Ask the venue owner to add you as a DJ, then reload this page.

unavailable.title: We couldn't load the queue
unavailable.body: Check the connection and try again.

errors.unavailable: The change didn't reach the server. The queue was reloaded.
errors.staleNight: The night changed. The queue was reloaded.
errors.notStaff: You're no longer staff at this venue.

queue.title: Queue
queue.nothingSingingHint: Press Start on the next song when the singer is ready.
queue.empty: The queue is empty. Guest requests show up here within seconds.
queue.pinnedHint: This song stays in this place; the fair order arranges the others around it. Use the pin button to give it back to the fair order.
queue.autoStart: Auto-start the next song after Done

drag.instructions: To pick up a song, press Space or Enter. Use the up and down arrows to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, Escape to cancel.
drag.dropped: {title} dropped at place {place} and stays there.

player.title: Player
player.error: YouTube couldn't play this version. Try another one.
player.emptyHint: Start a song from the queue, or wait for the next request.
player.noVideos: No karaoke video is linked to this song. Load it in VirtualDJ.
player.noEmbeddable: This song's versions can't play inside the app. Open one on YouTube or load it in VirtualDJ.

mixer.title: Mixer
mixer.micDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser's site settings.
mixer.micUnsupported: This browser can't route the microphone.
mixer.micHint: The mic plays through the default speakers via the browser; the venue's hardware mixer keeps driving the PA.
mixer.masterHint: Cuts music and mic together. Use it between songs or when the host talks.

tableCard.tally: {waiting, plural, =0 {none waiting} one {# waiting} other {# waiting}}{pending, plural, =0 {} other { · # awaiting approval}} · {sung, plural, =0 {nothing sung} one {# sung} other {# sung}}

admin.title: Venue admin
admin.demoHint: Supabase isn't configured, so changes stay in this browser for a few hours.

notStaff.title: You're not on any venue's staff
notStaff.body: Ask the venue owner to add you as an admin, then reload this page.

notAdmin.title: You're a DJ here, not an admin
notAdmin.body: Tables, the QR sheet and the rules are managed by the venue's owner or admin. Ask them to promote you if you need access.

unavailable.title: We couldn't load the venue
unavailable.body: Check the connection and try again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.tables: {total, plural, =0 {No tables yet} one {# table} other {# tables}}, {active, plural, =0 {none active} one {# active} other {# active}}
overview.djHint: Run the night here: queue with drag and drop, player and mixer. Hover a table name to see who sits there and when its turn comes. Music keeps playing while you move between admin tabs.
overview.catalog: {count, plural, =0 {No songs yet} one {# active song} other {# active songs}} in the catalog

tonight.title: Tables tonight
tonight.hint: Who sits at each table, since when, what they are waiting for and what they sang. Updates on its own.
tonight.summary: {openTables, plural, =0 {No open tables} one {# open table} other {# open tables}} · {guests, plural, =0 {no guests} one {# guest} other {# guests}} · {waiting, plural, =0 {nothing waiting} one {# song waiting} other {# songs waiting}} · {sung, plural, =0 {nothing sung yet} one {# sung} other {# sung}}
tonight.nightClosed: No night is open. Each table fills in once the DJ opens the night and guests sit down.
tonight.counts: {guests, plural, =0 {no guests} one {# guest} other {# guests}} · {songs, plural, =0 {no songs} one {# song} other {# songs}}
tonight.noGuests: No one has sat down yet.

tables.title: Tables
tables.hint: Each table has a QR code and a short typed code. Deactivated tables keep their history but guests can't join them.
tables.empty: No tables yet. Add the first one above.
tables.confirmRegenerate: Replace the typed code of {label}? Printed sheets with the old code stop working; the QR keeps working.

errors.duplicateLabel: A table with that label already exists.
errors.codeExhausted: We couldn't find a free code. Try again.
errors.notFound: That table no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.notAdmin: Only the venue's owner or admin can change tables.
errors.unavailable: The change didn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.

catalog.title: Song catalog
catalog.hint: Guests can only request songs from this list. Upload your VirtualDJ library or a CSV; uploading again updates the songs you already have.
catalog.demoHint: Demo: imports change this browser's copy of the catalog only. Guest search keeps the demo songs.
catalog.counts: {active, plural, =0 {No active songs} one {# active song} other {# active songs}}{inactive, plural, =0 {} other {, # hidden}}

upload.title: Import songs
upload.formats: CSV, VirtualDJ database.xml, or a VirtualDJ playlist or saved folder (.vdjfolder). Up to 25 MB.
upload.vdjHint: Tip: database.xml holds your whole music library. To import only karaoke tracks, save your karaoke folder in VirtualDJ as a playlist and upload that file.

preview.title: Ready to import
preview.found: {count, plural, =0 {No songs found} one {# song found} other {# songs found}}
preview.skipped: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} without a title or artist
preview.deactivate: Hide songs that are not in this file
preview.deactivateHint: Use this when the file is your full catalog. Hidden songs keep their history and come back when a later file includes them.

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.noTitleColumn: We couldn't find a title column. The first row must name the columns, for example: title,artist,language,duration,file
errors.unknownXml: This XML file isn't a VirtualDJ database or playlist.
errors.tooManyRows: The file has more than 50,000 songs. Split it and import each part.
errors.notAdmin: Only the venue's owner or admin can change the catalog.
errors.unavailable: The import didn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.busy: Another import is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.invalid: The import was rejected. Reload the page and try again.
errors.notFound: The import was stopped. Start it again.
errors.nothingImported: Nothing was imported, so no songs were hidden.
errors.upload: The file couldn't be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.

qr.title: QR sheet
qr.hint: {count, plural, =0 {No active tables to print.} one {One card, A4.} other {# cards, two per row on A4.}} Cut along the borders and place one on each table.
qr.unavailable: We couldn't load the tables. Check the connection and try again.
qr.noTables: There are no active tables. Add tables first, then come back to print.

settings.title: Settings

rules.title: Queue rules
rules.hint: Rules apply to the next night you open; a night that is already running keeps the rules it started with.
rules.fairnessHint: How the queue alternates between tables or singers.
rules.maxSingersPerSongHint: At least 1. Only matters when duets are allowed.
rules.nightCutoffMinutesBeforeCloseHint: Leave empty to accept requests until the night closes.
rules.requireHostApprovalHint: New requests wait for the DJ before they enter the queue.
rules.allowDuetsHint: More than one singer on a request.
rules.hostPriorityEnabledHint: A higher priority sorts a request earlier.

settings.saved: Saved. The next night you open uses these rules.
settings.savedDemo: Saved in this browser's demo venue.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a venue name (up to 80 characters).
errors.notAdmin: Only the venue's owner or admin can change settings.
errors.unavailable: The settings didn't reach the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.field: Enter a whole number of {min} or more.
errors.fieldNullable: Enter a whole number of {min} or more, or leave empty.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That link is broken or the page has moved.
